target_text: // Native K only: a packed plane has no contiguous rows.
body:
**[comments] Rule 2, restates identifiers: shorten**

'native K only' restates the requires clause !k_vnni::layout_on<head_size> on all four views, and 'It is reached through k.as_view()' restates k_vnni_tensor::as_view, which the member's type names. The reason the views exclude packed K is the one fact that stays.

Proposed:
```cpp
  // Native K only: a packed plane has no contiguous rows.
```
